test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Four number-triads have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.

(NOTE: The second and third numbers in the given number-triads are formed by performing a certain operation on the first number. The same operation is followed in all the number-triads except one. Find that odd number-triad.)
solution: Logic : (1st number + 3rd number) = 2nd number So, • Option - (1) : 84 : 294 : 210 84 + 210 = 294 2 = 30 (LHS = RHS) • Option - (2) : 68 : 238 : 170
